newsitem.title: USA: A. Schulman sees soft auto sales in Q4.
newsitem.headline: A. Schulman sees soft auto sales in Q4.

text.p: A. Schulman said on Thursday that soft sales and labor disruptions in the automotive industry, along with summer model changeovers, would influence its fourth quarter earnings.
However, the plastic and rubber products company also said it expected moderately improved economic conditions in European markets.
"Overall, we anticipate improved results for 1997 which should be in line with our original plans," said company president Terry Haines.
"Although the strength of the U.S. dollar will continue to have an adverse effect in the months ahead, we have a strong level of orders in our Eruopean operations," Haines added.

A. Schulman posted net income for its third quarter of $13.7 million, or $0.37 per share, on revenues of $259.2 million. The results compared favorably with net income of $12.1 million, or $0.32 per share, on revenues of $254.4 million reported for the same quarter last year.
